_provenance: Position-choice spread (RStd) for the 6 measurable models, computed by build/cq_rstd.py over the all-band cultural runs (~/cq_data/out/vAgrid_cult). RStd is the population standard deviation across the five answer positions of the fraction of items for which each position was chosen; 0 = uniform chooser. 700 items x 5 cyclic rotations = 3500 instances per model/precision.
